title: GPT-4o joins the text endpoint as openai-large
summary:
GPT-4o arrived on the text endpoint, and the vision API got documentation for people who prefer maps to archaeology.

The text API now exposes GPT-4o through Azure under the openai-large model name, with the endpoint work landing alongside the integration. One model label, a larger brain behind it.

Documentation was added for the vision API, giving builders a clearer path from image input to useful model output.
